zh: Anthropic已于10月26日公开提交S-1，拟以ANT代码在Nasdaq Global Select Market上市；公告明确发行股数和价格区间未定、注册声明尚未生效。本轮回读公司新闻与SEC原件，尚未取得其后生效、定价、最终招股或交割文件，现行证据状态仍是已递表；不能把媒体预期的估值或11月窗口填入现金。OpenAI的新一轮融资同样尚未取得正式成交与付款证据，IPO时间和私募谈判分别保持待核；下文SoftBank已完成出资则独立保留。[Anthropic递表公告](https://www.anthropic.com/news/s1-sec)、[SEC S-1封面](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026067168/anthropicpbc-sx1.htm)、[公司新闻入口](https://www.anthropic.com/news)

V1.9 在 10 月底记录 Anthropic 于 10 月 26 日公开递交 S-1，拟以 ANT 在纳斯达克上市。随后公司在 11 月 18 日定价，20 日确认公开发行及同期私募交割。发行数据和净所得估计见本章 11 月 21 日更新。10 月底对另一家公司融资谈判的观察保留原日期，已完成的 SoftBank 出资仍按独立事件记载。 [10 月 26 日递表公告](https://www.anthropic.com/news/s1-sec) · [11 月 20 日交割公告](https://www.anthropic.com/news/ipo-close)
| Anthropic，10月26日宣布已提交拟IPO的公开S-1；声明尚未生效，股数与价格区间未定 | 公开上市申请进入可观察阶段；尚不是已成交融资 | 后续生效、定价、交割及净到账得到正式文件确认：更新融资能力 | 延期、缩量或未完成：保留资金缺口；不能预填IPO收入或用申请确认经营回本 |
| Anthropic，11 月 20 日确认 IPO 和同期私募交割 | 可核实已完成发行，归公司毛所得约 1,175.78 亿美元 | 后续披露最终发行费用、可动用现金及客户回款，更新各财期支付能力 | 临近付款日仍有收款延期或提款条件变化，核对实际资金缺口 |
截至2026年10月31日，当前判断是：
V1.9 在 2026 年 10 月 31 日的判断是：
Anthropic的单季经营转盈仍是重要反证，但IPO尚未取得生效、定价或交割证据。
Anthropic 的单季经营转盈属于 V1.9 当时的反证。11 月 20 日交割及前九个月财务详见本章更新和第三章。
其发行股数与价格区间仍未确定，不能把这些截至6月的经营表现与10月递表混成IPO完成或融资到账。
这些截至 6 月的经营结果与 11 月已完成的发行归入各自期间。
Anthropic则要继续核申请生效、定价、交割与净到账，10月26日提交申请尚不能结算成已完成融资。
Anthropic 已确认发行交割。接下来检验最终净所得、客户收款和设备合同的实际付款时点。
en: Anthropic publicly filed an S-1 on 26 October for a proposed Nasdaq Global Select Market listing under ANT. Its announcement explicitly leaves share count and price range undetermined, with the registration statement not yet effective. This review reread company news and SEC originals but obtained no subsequent effectiveness, pricing, final prospectus or closing documents; evidence status remains filed. Media valuation expectations or a November window cannot enter cash balances. Formal closing and payment evidence for OpenAI's new funding round likewise remains unobtained; IPO timing and private negotiations remain separately unverified, while SoftBank's completed contribution below is independently retained. [Anthropic filing announcement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/s1-sec), [SEC S-1 cover](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026067168/anthropicpbc-sx1.htm), [Company news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)

At the October 31 V1.9 cutoff, Anthropic's public S-1 of October 26 recorded a proposed Nasdaq listing under ANT. The company priced the offering on November 18 and confirmed its IPO and concurrent private placement closed on November 20. The November 21 update above records the offering terms and estimated net proceeds. The October evidence on another company's funding negotiations has its own date. SoftBank's completed contribution below remains a separately documented event. [October filing announcement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/s1-sec) · [November 20 closing announcement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/ipo-close)

| Anthropic, October 26 announcement of a public S-1 for a proposed IPO; registration statement not yet effective, share count and price range undetermined | The public listing application has entered an observable stage; not completed financing | Formal documents confirm subsequent effectiveness, pricing, settlement and net receipts: update financing capacity | Delay, downsizing or noncompletion: retain the funding gap; do not pre-enter IPO proceeds or treat an application as proof of operating payback |

| Anthropic confirmed completion of its IPO and concurrent private placement on November 20 | The issuer raised gross proceeds of approximately USD 117.578 billion across the two transactions | Verify final expenses, available liquidity and collections in subsequent disclosures | If customer collections lag or financing conditions change, measure the cash shortfall against dated obligations |
As of October 31, 2026, the current judgment is:
Anthropic's quarterly move into operating profit remains important disconfirming evidence, but evidence of IPO effectiveness, pricing or settlement has not yet been obtained.
Anthropic's quarterly move into operating profit was important counterevidence in V1.9. See the dated update above and Chapter 3 for the November 20 closing and the nine-month financial results.
Issue share count and price range remain undetermined. Operating performance through June cannot be combined with the October filing to imply IPO completion or receipt of financing.
These operating results through June and the completed November financing belong to their respective periods.
For Anthropic, continue checking application effectiveness, pricing, settlement and net receipts; filing on October 26 cannot yet be scored as completed financing.
Anthropic has confirmed its offering closed. Check final net proceeds, customer collections and actual payments under equipment contracts in subsequent disclosures.
